label: DESI/Legacy Survey DR11.0 North
name: Legacy Survey Data Release 11.0, Northern Region
description: The DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys map the extragalactic sky in optical bands, with unWISE forced photometry in W1-W4 through NEOWISE-Reactivation year 11. This catalog covers the DR11 northern region (Dec >= 32.375 deg and north of the Galactic plane) with Tractor sources from BASS and MzLS 'grz' imaging (reductions of data included in DR9). Each row joins the standard sweeps files with the extra, light curve and photo-z sweeps files. The default column set is the 115 columns of the standard sweeps; all 185 columns are available with columns='all'.

notes.title: Combining with the southern region
notes.content:
The DR11 southern region (DECam) is a separate catalog: Legacy Survey DR11.0 South. Combine both with LSDB:

lsdb.open_catalog("http://slac.data.lsdb.io:10942/lsdb/legacysurvey_dr11.0_north").concat(lsdb.open_catalog("http://slac.data.lsdb.io:10942/lsdb/legacysurvey_dr11.0_south"))

Where the two regions' footprints overlap, the same object may appear in both catalogs.
